messages:
nightly-bot: nightly eval alert: pset_v33 failed 6.4%↑ on intent-coverage vs baseline (model: rwd-open-7b-q2a), CI run 2212345600. Summary + examples attached.
Jin H: seeing this now. did pset33 just land last night? :eyes:
Amir: yep merged at 2212341000 — mostly small wording and one normalization change: trim trailing punctuation in examples. PR: https://git.internal/repo/promptbank/pulls/482
Priya: which prompt family? link?
Amir: intent-family -> lots of short Q/A forms. The normalization was supposed to reduce token churn.
Jin H: interesting. tokenizer change on serving side recently? we did a kernel/quant rollout earlier but no tokenizer change AFAIK.
Carlos: there was a micro update in tokenization mapping for whitespace handling in the quant runtime image (container: rwd-runtime:2026.03.14-qfix). It's in infra release notes but flagged low risk.
Marta: can we repro locally by running pset_v33 against rwd-open-7b-q2a with and without trimming? small script:
```
python eval.py --pset pset_v33 --model rwd-open-7b-q2a --normalize --no-cache
```
Jin H: ran quick repro — enabling the normalization increases false negatives on 18 cases (examples pasted). Looks like the prompt ending punctuation was important for a few templates.
Priya: ugh. was the trim intended to be applied at model-serving or in prompt authoring? Amir you changed promptset to expect trimming, right?
Amir: I normalized promptbank to remove trailing punctuation to standardize across authors. The idea: avoid duplicate prompts that differ only by punctuation.
Carlos: but runtime change also normalizes incoming prompts now. we effectively double-normalized -> some prompts lost signal.
Jin H: double normalization would remove subtle signals like trailing question mark in templates that help the model classify intent.
Marta: attaching two example pairs (before/after):
- "How do I reset my password?" -> "How do I reset my password" (model shifted predicted class to 'general_info' instead of 'account_reset')
- "Cancel subscription." -> "Cancel subscription" (lost imperative cue in a few cases)
QA-bot: failing test ids: p33-intent-014, p33-intent-023, p33-intent-047 ... full list in attached csv.
Priya: options: rollback pset33, revert runtime whitespace change, or rebaseline pset33 (accept new labels). Rebaseline seems risky since semantics changed.
Amir: I can open a PR to revert the normalization in promptbank quickly if we want rollback. But we should also decide about runtime normalization patch — it's probably safer to revert that too.
Lena: @Lena here — prefer minimal blast radius. Can we do a canary: revert promptbank normalization (fast), run nightly canary on subset, pause runtime change in canary pool? If that recovers accuracy we can roll forward proper fix.
Carlos: canary pool for runtime already exists. I can hold the runtime image from progressing and route pset eval to the old image for one run.
Jin H: I'll prepare a small set of focused examples to monitor. If revert fixes >80% of regressions we merge revert and schedule a follow-up to design idempotent normalization.
Marta: I'll open the revert PR now: https://git.internal/repo/promptbank/pulls/490 — includes test to avoid double-normalization.
Amir: ack. I also pushed a branch with a safe normalization shim that is idempotent: strip only zero-width whitespace and preserve final punctuation. PR coming.
Priya: can we run a quick canary eval? Jin row-me? (cc @Carlos for runtime)
Jin H: kicked off canary eval: job 2212345700; will post results in ~3m.
QA-bot: canary run started job=2212345700, using promptbank branch revert-pr-490 and runtime image rwd-runtime:2026.03.10
Jin H: canary finished — intent regressions dropped from 6.4% to 0.9%. Most fixes correspond to the 18 examples earlier.
Lena: good. approve revert PR once CI passes. @Amir please rework normalization approach in a new PR and add unit tests covering punctuation signals.
Amir: will do. thanks all. I'll hold any more promptbank merges until new PR lands.
Carlos: I'll keep runtime image pinned for one more day and coordinate a controlled rollout with infra.
Marta: merging revert PR now after CI green.
Jin H: note for postmortem: add automated check in nightly eval to flag when normalization churn correlates with label flips (we lacked that signal).
Priya: agree. creating follow-up ticket: INTERNAL-ml-7890 for eval-sanity checks + canary automation.
Lena: thanks team. closing thread after postmortem doc and ticket created.
Amir: postmortem draft incoming.
QA-bot: job logs and failing case CSV uploaded to: https://artifacts.internal/audit/2212345700
